name: Bee
style: low-poly chibi, flat colours, modelled stripes (Quaternius 2021)

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 54 named the Bee from Quaternius's poly.pizza "Cute Creatures" set; poly.pizza is behind a Cloudflare challenge. The same author's Textured Cute Monster Pack (Aug 2020, OpenGameArt, the zip the ghost entry uses) has a Bee with the plan's four clips, but its yellow and black stripes are painted across a few large faces of the texture: flattened to flat colours (16 clusters at face UV centroids) it became a near-black blob with odd yellow patches and no stripes, which does not read as a bee. This is the same character as remodelled for Quaternius's Ultimate Platformer Pack (Dec 2021, itch.io free download; License.txt in the zip: CC0 1.0), Enemies/FBX/Bee.fbx: the stripes, eyes, teeth, tongue and wings are geometry with their own flat materials, and it carries the same four clips (Flying, Bite_Front, HitRecieve, Death). Colours on indigo: the yellow body is practical shading to iris amber, the stripes and the curled antennae hair-dark shading to sky navy, the eyes hair-dark, the wings line white shading to moon, teeth sclera, tongue accent red. Flying is the only idle and loops (wings beat, body bobs); Bite_Front, HitRecieve and Death play once. Death rolls the bee onto its back and would sink 28 mm, so it clamps to the ground. At rest and in every clip the round body touches y = 0: for a bee in the air, lift the root in the film. Height 0.6 m (body plus antennae) is a chibi choice for this cute-monster scale: a real honeybee is about 1.5 cm; 0.6 m puts it at the knee-to-hip of a 1.7 m adult, beside the pack's other monsters (the ghost is 0.8 m). The face points +Z.
